info.name: Sonatype Nexus Repository Manager assets Security management: users API
Retrieve a list of users. For SAML user sources a limit of 1000 users will be applied.

params.name: userId
params.description: An optional term to search userids for.

params.name: source
params.description: An optional user source to restrict the search to.

items.docs: Retrieve a list of users. For SAML user sources a limit of 1000 users will be applied.

info.name: Get user token metadata for the given user.

params.name: userId
params.description: The userId of the user to get the token for

params.name: realm
params.description: The realm of the user to get the token for

items.docs: Retrieves metadata for an existing user token. Both userId and realm are required parameters. The passCode is never returned in this response.

info.name: Create a user token for the given user.

params.name: userId
params.description: The userId of the user to create the token for

params.name: realm
params.description: The realm of the user to create the token for

items.docs: Creates a new user token for the specified user. Both userId and realm are required parameters.

info.name: Delete the user token for the given user.

params.name: userId
params.description: The userId of the user to delete the token for

params.name: realm
params.description: The realm of the user to delete the token for

items.docs: Deletes the user token for the specified user. Both userId and realm are required parameters. The token will be invalidated immediately and can no longer be used.

info.name: Reset the user token for the given user.

params.name: userId
params.description: The userId of the user to reset the token for

params.name: realm
params.description: The realm of the user to reset the token for

items.docs: Resetting the user token will invalidate the current token and force a new token to be created the next time it is accessed. This endpoint is deprecated, use DELETE /user-token instead.
